subject: Post-discovery: locking demo slot + onboarding security & procurement
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@novushealth.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: locking demo slot + onboarding security & procurement

Hi Maya / Arjun —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Novus Health is prioritizing a pilot to validate sub-second inference on anonymized triage notes, with an eventual goal of embedding LLM summarization into the clinician workflow. Key non-functional reqs you flagged were: SOC 2 evidence, data residency constraints (US), and procurement turnaround within 3–4 weeks.

Suggested next step: 60-minute technical demo + Q&A where Marissa will walk through the runtime behavior and Monica can answer security questions. Please pick one of these windows (all PT):
- Tues Jul 7 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jul 8 — 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jul 9 — 09:00–10:00

If none work, propose two alternative slots and I’ll coordinate. I’ve looped Mon (security) and Rafa (legal/procurement) to help with SOC2, the MSA, and SOW. I attached the discovery notes and uploaded the artifacts to the shared folder (link below).

Attachments: discovery-notes-20270630.txt (short notes)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovusDemoAssets

Next steps after we lock a slot:
- Marissa runs the demo (benchmarks + live inference on sandbox data)
- Monica shares a short SOC2 summary + evidence artifacts
- Rafael sends an initial SOW + redline-ready MSA for review

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwoodinference.com

--

> 
> - Maya
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@novushealth.com>

Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: locking demo slot + onboarding security & procurement

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Wed Jul 8 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our engineering lead (Arjun) and me.

Two asks before the demo so we can prepare the right folks:
1) Can you share a brief SOC 2 summary (scope & evidence types) and a note on whether Redwood supports US-only data residency for the pilot?
2) Procurement wants a draft SOW and any standard MSA so they can start their internal review (we’ll include procurement@novushealth.com).

If you can loop security and legal on this thread that’d be great. Also please confirm whether the demo will require any network/VPN access to our environment or if you’ll demo from Redwood’s sandbox.

Appreciate it — looking forward to Wed.

—Maya
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@novushealth.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: locking demo slot + onboarding security & procurement

Hi Maya — great, Wed Jul 8 14:00–15:00 PT is tentatively locked on our side. Confirmed attendees: Marissa (Solutions Eng), Monica (Security), Rafael (Legal/Procurement), Diego (AE).

Answers to your asks:
- SOC2: attaching a short SOC2-Summary.pdf that lists scope (infra + controls for hosted API) and typical evidence artifacts. Monica will follow up with any additional artifacts you need.
- Data residency: we support US-only deployments for Private/Dedicated pilots; hosted production can be region-restricted — Monica can confirm specifics for your pilot.
- Procurement artifacts: uploading a redline-ready MSA (redlined-MSA.docx) and a SOW template (SOW-template-novus.docx) to the Drive link below. Rafael will add any Novus-specific clauses you request.
- Demo network needs: we’ll run the demo from Redwood’s sandbox environment — no VPN required. If you want to demo from a Novus environment later in the pilot we can coordinate a secure jump-host flow (more on that during the demo).

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Summary.pdf, redlined-MSA.docx, SOW-template-novus.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovusDemoAssets

Rafael / Monica — can you confirm whether the attached MSA + SOW look like a good starting point for Novus procurement? And Mon, can you confirm the US-only residency statement?

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Jul 8 once Mike from our scheduling system confirms the resource (should be shortly).

Diego

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: locking demo slot + onboarding security & procurement

Thanks everyone — I’ll own the security checklist for the pilot and join the demo on Jul 8 (14:00 PT). Quick notes from my side: 
- Confirmed: Redwood can scope a US-only pilot environment (we’ll need a signed SOW to lock region and retention).
- Evidence: attached security-evidence-pack.zip contains a SOC2 overview, control mappings, and a recent third-party attestation stub. If Novus needs encrypted-at-rest specifics or key management integration notes I can add a short appendix.
- Network: the initial demo from our sandbox requires no inbound network access. If later we do a Novus-hosted run we’ll request a single outbound port (HTTPS) to the jump host; I’ll provide exact IPs if/when we schedule that.

Rafael — happy to sync offline if you want to pre-review procurement language.

See you Jul 8 — I’ll accept the invite when it arrives.

Monica Patel
Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
